CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for **WeatherNode**, a self-hosted website for your personal weather station, maintained by CentauriPrime.
WeatherNode shows live readings, forecasts, radar, history and statistics, and works with Ecowitt, Davis WeatherLink, Weather Underground, Ambient Weather, WeatherFlow Tempest and more.
Also includes Blink Camera Relay, an experimental Blink live-view bridge with a dashboard, RTSP and ONVIF in one container.
Unraid Advanced VM is a beta native plugin for VM hardware, protection and recovery.
Intel GPU Firmware is a public alpha for inspecting Intel GPUs and explicitly confirmed updates of compatible newer GSC firmware using official Intel tools. Hardware support is capability-based; see its template for validation limits.
For questions and bug reports, use the Support link in the relevant app template.
